items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: On Severn and Woods, where Slim Jenkins is at.

ctx.x: Yeah. With all of his band. Yeah. And then what happened? Where'd you go?

To Akamacha, and then after we left the Deluxe, I mean after we left the Percola, we played the Creole, then we, uh, Jolly wanted us- The Creole where? Cafe here. On Severn and Woods, where Slim Jenkins is at.
This is, what town is this now? Oakland, California. Oh, in Oakland.
